title: Simple Chroma Keys
description: Terracotta Blocks Replaced with Chroma Keys colors for easier video edition
body:
## Need a clean green screen in Minecraft?
![player standing on green screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97148fea1da243b86bfcdf8b290ae5ca0cae635d.png)

This resource pack replaces 4 Terracotta blocks with vibrant chroma key colors, making it easy to create backgrounds for videos, screenshots, cinematics, and visual effects.

Perfect for content creators who want fast and reliable green screen recording directly inside Minecraft.

### Blocks Modified:
- Lime Terracotta to Green Chroma Key
- Light Blue Terracotta to Blue Chroma Key
- Pink Terracotta to Pink Chroma Key
- Red Terracotta to Red Chroma Key
